pages.text: $(thing)Air curing$() is the slowest and simplest method. The rack must not be getting rained on, and sky light at the block above the rack must be at least $(item)8$().
Air curing requires $(item)72,000 ticks$(), or about $(item)3 Minecraft days$() of valid air-curing time. The timer only advances while the requirements remain valid.
pages.title: Time

pages.text: Covered outdoor racks are useful because air curing does not require direct sky access. Just make sure the cover does not reduce sky light below 8. If another curing method becomes valid, the rack can switch methods and the final batch may count as mixed.
pages.title: Practical Setup
